LEGAL SERVICES AGREEMENT
1. IDENTIFICATION OF PARTIES. This agreement is made between LAW OFFICES
OF DANIEL P. BEAVER, hereafter referred to as “Law Firm,” and RENE PEINADO, hereafter
referred to as “Client.” .
This agreement is required by Business and Professions Code section 6148 and is intended to -
fulfill the requirements of that section. |
2. LEGAL SERVICES TO BE PROVIDED. The legal services to be provided by Law
Firm to Client are as follows: Representation of Client in connection with litigation known as .
Rene Peinado v. Saxe Mortgage Company, et al., San Francisco Superior Court No. 999022.
3. RESPONSIBILITIES OF LAW FIRM AND CLIENT. Law Firm will perform the |
legal services called for under this agreement, keep Client informed of progress and
developments, and respond promptly to Client’s inquiries and communications. Client will be
truthful and cooperative with Law Firm; keep Law Firm reasonably informed of developments |
and of Client's address, telephone numbers and whereabouts; and timely make any payments
required by this agreement. .
4. ATTORNEY’S FEES. Client will pay Law Firm for attorney’s fees for the legal .
services provided under this agreement at the hourly rate of $175.00. Law Firm will charge in .
increments of one tenth of an hour, rounded off for each particular activity to the nearest one
tenth of an hour. The minimum time charged for any particular activity will be one tenth of an |
hour. we |
Law Firm will charge for all activities undertaken in providing legal services to Client under |
this agreement, including, but not limited to, the following: conferences, court sessions, and
depositions (preparation and participation); correspondence and legal documents (review and
preparation); legal research; and telephone conversations. When two or more of Law Firm’s
personnel work on the matter at the same time, such as in conferences between them, the hourly |
rate of each will be charged.
If, while this agreement is in effect, Law Firm increases the hourly rates being charged to :

Law Firm, provided Client executes and returns a substitution-of-attorney form immediately on
its receipt from Law Firm if Law Firm is Client’s attorney of record in any proceeding.
5. COSTS. Client will pay all “costs” in connection with Law Firm’s representation of
Client under this agreement. Costs may be advanced by Law Firm and then billed to Client
unless the costs can be met out of client deposits that are applicable toward costs. Law Firm may
in some instances request that Client pay certain costs directly to the provider of outside services.
Costs include, but are not limited to, court filing fees, deposition costs, consultant and expert fees
and expenses, investigation costs, long-distance telephone charges, messenger service fees,
photocopying expenses, and process server fees.
6. DEPOSIT FOR FEES. Client will pay to Law Firm an initial deposit of $4,000.00, to be
received by Law Firm by November 29, 1999, and to be applied against attorney’s fees and costs
incurred by Client. Said sum shall be deposited by Law Firm in an interest-bearing trust account. .
Client authorizes Law Firm to withdraw the principal from the trust account to pay attorney’s |
fees and costs as they are incurred by Clients. If, at the termination of services under this
! agreement, the total amount incurred by Clients for attorney’s fees and costs is less than the
amount of the initial deposit, the difference will be refunded to Clients.
Law Firm will notify Client whenever the full amount of any deposit has been applied to
attorney’s fees and costs incurred by Clients. Within 15 days after each notification is mailed, |
Client will pay to Law Firm an additional deposit in the same amount as the initial one. Deposit
of such additional amounts will be made in the same manner as for the initial deposit. Client
, authorizes Law Firm to withdraw the principal from the trust account to pay attorney’s fees and
| costs as they are incurred by Client. Such additional deposits will be fully refundable. If, at the |
termination of services under this agreement, there have been two or more deposits and the total |
amount incurred by Clients for attorney’s fees and costs is less than the total amount of all
deposits, the difference will be refunded to Clients.
7. STATEMENTS AND PAYMENTS. Law Firm will send Client monthly statements |
indicating attémey’s fees and costs sncurred and their basis, any amounts applied from deposits,
and any currént,balance owed. If no attorney’s fees or costs are incurred for a particular month,
or if they are minimal, the statement may be held and combined with that for the following
month. Any balance will be paid in full within 30 days after the statement is mailed. |
8 TERMINATION. Client or Law Firm may terminate the employment of Law Firm at
any time. Client and Law Firm understand that Law Firm reserves the right to withdraw from
this representation if Client fails to honor this agreement or for any just reason as permitted or |
required under the California Code of Professional Responsibility or as permitted by the Rules of
Court of the State of California. Notification of such withdrawal shall be made in writing to |
Client. In the event of such withdrawal, Client agrees to promptly pay Law Firm for all other
fees, charges and expenses incurred as outlined above, prior to the date of such withdrawal, and |

however, Client acknowledge that Law Firm has made no promises or guarantees regarding the
